titleFormatted.en: Add state monitor for [[device]], capability [[capability]], active value(s) [[active_values]], label when true [[true_label]], label when false [[false_label]], name [[name]]

hint.en: For a device with a reliable ACTIVE/STANDBY signal of its own — a door, a presence sensor, an on/off switch, or an appliance's own multi-value state (e.g. "Power Off"/"Running") instead of guessing from a power threshold. Tracks time spent in BOTH states. If the device also has a power/energy capability, it's tracked automatically alongside the state signal.
Boolean and multi-value capabilities on this device are shown (contact, motion, on/off, an appliance's own state, etc.).

title.en: Active value(s) (only for a multi-value capability)

hint.en: Comma-separated list of the raw values that count as active for a multi-value capability (check the device's advanced settings for its exact value names). Leave blank for a plain true/false capability — required otherwise.

What the raw value true (or an active_values match) means for this device — check its current value against its current physical state if unsure. Used only for display, doesn't affect what gets tracked (both states are always tracked).
